title: Export Size Growth Trend
dataSources: Photo archives (`memory:takeout`), journal OCR (`memory:journal`), postcard records (`memory:postcard`), memory linking (`memory:photo`), archive checks (`memory:ops`).
app: Life-logging and memory telemetry — Google Photos Takeout archives, journal OCR queues, and postcard collection logs — streamed to Splunk HEC via exports and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=memory:takeout archive_name=* export_size_gb=*
| bin _time span=1mon
| stats sum(export_size_gb) as metric by _time archive_name
| sort 0 _time archive_name
description: Trends monthly export size GB by archive for backup growth.
value: Monthly trend lines show whether backup growth are improving, stalling, or becoming unbalanced over time.
implementation: Normalize `archive_name` on `memory:takeout` events and store the fields needed to calculate monthly export size GB.
visualization: Line chart of monthly export size GB by archive.
grandmaExplanation: It produces how export size GB changes month by month for each archive so you can see whether backup growth are heading the right way.
